PM Modi, others pay tribute to Indira Gandhi on birth anniversary

Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with other leaders, paid tribute to former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi on her 109th birth anniversary. The event marked the remembrance of the 'Iron Lady' of India.
